title: Cerebral Arteries and Circle of Willis Anatomy
author: NASA / Wikimedia Commons contributor
caption: Anatomical illustration of the cerebral arteries at the base of the brain (Circle of Willis), which dilate in response to elevated arterial pCO2.
alt_text: Detailed anatomical illustration of the ventral brain surface showing the Circle of Willis arterial ring.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates the cerebral vasculature whose hypercapnia-mediated vasodilation drives CO2-induced headache (CLIFF-040, p.1).
